Definition: probably akin to the base of G4987; a funereal receptacle (urn, coffin), i.e. (by analogy) a bier:--bier.
BiblicalUsage: The bier is the frame that carries the dead, and Jesus came and touched it. They that bare the young man stood still, and He said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise. One touch stopped the funeral.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the touch says He is not afraid of death, and the word Arise is the whole gospel in two words.
